title: 请求帮忙 & 礼貌拒绝

cards.mine: Can you help me a favour?

us.mine: Can you help me a favor?

cards.zh: 你介意跟我换个座位吗？
cards.mine: Is it convenient to change seat with me?
Sorry to make trouble for you.

cards.zh: 你能帮我看一下这个吗？
cards.en: Could you [[take a look at]] this?
cards.mine: Can you help me see this?
cards.note: help me + 动词常被滥用

cards.en: Could you [[give me a lift]] home?
cards.mine: Can you send me home?

us.en: Could you [[give me a ride]] home?

cards.mine: Do you need my help?
cards.note: need my help听起来有点居高临下

cards.mine: Give it to me.
Don't be polite, it's a small thing.
I owe you a favour.
This time maybe I can't.

cards.en: I'd love to, but I [[can't make it]].
cards.mine: I'm very want to go, but I have no time.
cards.note: can't make it=赶不上/去不了

cards.zh: 这周我真的挤不出时间
cards.en: I [[can't squeeze it in]] this week.
cards.mine: I really can't take out time this week.

cards.zh: 我现在手上事情太多了
cards.en: I've got [[too much on my plate]] right now.
cards.mine: I have too many things on my hands now.

cards.zh: 下班后我尽量不碰工作
cards.en: I try to [[switch off]] after hours.
cards.mine: I don't check work messages after work time.

cards.en: Can we [[push it back]] a bit?
cards.mine: Can we change a time?
Can we next time?

cards.zh: 不好意思临时放你鸽子
cards.en: Sorry for [[bailing on you]] last minute.
cards.mine: Sorry I cancel you suddenly.
It's all my wrong.

cards.zh: 不好意思，那件事我给忘了
cards.en: Sorry, I [[dropped the ball]] on that.
cards.mine: Sorry, I forgot that thing.
If you can't, it doesn't matter.
cards.note: No pressure 让对方好拒绝

cards.mine: Sorry to let you wait so long.

cards.en: Could you [[keep an eye on]] my bag?
cards.mine: Can you help me look at my bag?
cards.note: 看着东西用keep an eye on

cards.zh: 不用了谢谢，我自己可以
cards.mine: No need, thank you.

cards.en: That time [[doesn't really work for me]].
cards.mine: That time is not convenient for me.

cards.en: [[No rush]], whenever you get a chance.
cards.mine: Not urgent, when you are free.
